messages:
Mike (AE): Quick check-in on AcmeHealth POC -> legal sent MSA/DPA redlines. Need pricing confirmation + signing flow.
Sara (Sales Ops): Attached order form snippet below. Will prep DocuSign if legal ok.
Tom (SE): POC perf looks good on Dedicated A100-equivalent pool. Ops needs exact instance in order form to provision.
Mike (AE): Buyer wants 20% off for first 6 months and to sign with PO + e-sign. Can we confirm?
Amelia (Procurement): Acme prefers DocuSign then issue PO referencing envelope ID. Finance needs billing address and tax ID on DocuSign. Net30 ok.
Julia (Legal): Redlines summary: increase liability cap (requested $5M), EU data residency clause, DPA asks for subprocessor list + 30-day notice.
Mike (AE): $5M ask - is that a hard blocker?
Julia (Legal): For Dedicated, we can consider up to $3M with approvals. $5M requires exec/legal+insurance review.
Finance Bot: Note: projected ARR ~$144k -> >$100k triggers finance pre-approval checklist.
Sara (Sales Ops): Order form snippet:
Product: Redwood Dedicated - 1x A100-equivalent pool
Term: 12 months (auto-renew, 30-day opt-out)
Committed tokens: 100,000/mo
Unit price: $0.00012/token (20% promo, first 6 months)
Onboarding credit: $5,000 one-time
Billing: Invoice on PO receipt, Net30
Julia (Legal): Proposed compromises: liability cap $3M, subprocessor notice 45 days, provide subprocessor list within 10 days post-signature. I'll upload a redline in 24h.
Amelia (Procurement): If legal accepts 45 days we'll move fast. Confirm PO lines: "Dedicated runtime" and "Onboarding services".
Mike (AE): I'll present $3M/45-day compromise to buyer and request PO intent. If they insist on $5M, I'll escalate.
Sara (Sales Ops): Action items: Julia - redline (24h). Sara - draft DocuSign envelope (today). Amelia - confirm billing address and PO contact (EOD). Mike - confirm discount term with buyer.
